businessModel: None; free software, with a default search run by the same project
summary: monocles browser is an open-source Android browser based on Stoutner’s Privacy Browser. JavaScript and cookies are off by default, EasyList ad blocking is built in, and it defaults to the project’s own metasearch.
bestFor: F-Droid users who want a locked-down WebView browser
notFor: People who want a fully featured daily browser
Anyone who needs extensions or sync

pros.title: Locked down by default
pros.detail: JavaScript and cookies are off until enabled.

pros.title: Orbot support
pros.detail: Can route traffic through the Tor Orbot proxy.

pros.title: Open source
pros.detail: GPL-3.0 code on Codeberg and in F-Droid.

cons.title: Slow updates
cons.detail: The last release found is 1.9.3 from August 2025.

cons.title: Depends on system WebView
cons.detail: Security and compatibility depend on the phone’s WebView updates.

cons.title: Small feature set
cons.detail: No extensions, sync or password manager.

faq.q: Is monocles browser based on Privacy Browser?
faq.a: Yes. Its Codeberg page says it is based on Stoutner’s Privacy Browser.
The latest release found is 1.9.3 (August 2025), with releases roughly yearly.
The monocles metasearch engine, which says it does not save your IP or queries.
